add_alpha_policy.authority_discipline: any two independent families authorise exploration capital (price-relative / point-in-time information / confirmed un-overheated 20-day breakout); validated still needs decision-usable evidence on both the price and information sides, so a price pattern never promotes a leveraged name. While a family is still warming up, one family plus a price confirmation authorises HALF an exploration slice on a non-leveraged name — the exception retires itself when the activation counters fill
add_alpha_policy.discipline: Factor and peer residual share one price-relative family. An add also requires point-in-time information surprise or own-history attention acceleration, then a future-session price confirmation. Exploration is one 2.5% tranche per ticker and policy version, never a validated claim, and daily-reset leveraged products require validated evidence.

rules.binds: a leveraged product at or below the hard-stop line, or under a regime de-lever, must be cut or swapped
a hard stop is answered by the full position
no add or T trade on a name with an open risk breach
no add to a daily-reset leveraged product without validated evidence
an add stays inside cash and the single-name target
a risk-rule buy is the named target, paired with its sell, within the mandate's value
a buy may claim a risk rule only where a breach prescribes it

rule_outputs.how_to_read: weigh them, depart from them when the observations say otherwise, and name the departure; `clawock tool observations` returns the measurements underneath and `clawock tool compute` computes a feature you define

portfolio.risk_directive: ⛔ 0 仓位硬闸 + 2 杠杆止损触发。硬止损与 regime_delever 在无 may_stand 或有效 durable override 时，必须在 Judge 段出对应动作(driven_by=risk_rule,纪律性再平衡,不算听消息、不受 risk_on HOLD 默认约束)；单名/杠杆敞口/相关集群/β 四类上限必须逐条回应：减仓，或写明理由的持有，超限期间不得加仓；regime 对其余主动 call 只是策略参考。登记策略倾向2x→1x 同因子换仓，也可说明理由后卖出持有现金；买腿遵守处方(见各 action)。
